# Provenance

This directory is a synthetic offline fixture for Studium's end-to-end test.

It is not an official document of the Universidad de León, and it is not a copy of a course guide, problem sheet, or textbook. The course name, university, and degree in the test are labels the project stores. They do not assert that this text was issued by that university.

The hydrostatic relation `dp = rho * g * h` and the numbers below were written for the test so the server can replay them with its own arithmetic. Nothing here was fetched from the network.
